page.overview:
What is Attack on Demir?

During the era of the New Republic, the First Order launched an attack on the iron planet Demir in the Unknown Regions.

On the iron planet Demir, First Order stormtroopers, an AT-ST and TIE/sf space superiority fighters engaged Demirian warriors and ships. Captain Phasma led the stormtroopers into battle, taking down some of the Demirians. Phasma then told the stormtroopers that the AT-ST would clear the path to the Demirian stronghold. She then ordered the stormtroopers to be ready and not hesitate. Phasma then delivered a speech to the troops, stating they were another gun that she held. She went on to tell them that if their aim was not true, if the falter, they were no longer worthy of being held in her hand and no longer worthy to serve the First Order.

A stormtrooper warned Phasma about an incoming Demirian ship, causing Phasma to order the stormtroopers to get down as the ship was charging up to fire. The ship released a massive blast that destroyed the AT-ST and sent the stormtroopers to the ground. KM-8713 woke up and removed their helmet. They notice DB-7197, a trooper they went through basic training with, on the ground and helped him get up. As many of the injured troopers began to get up, KM-8713 reassured DB-7197 that they started this together and they would not leave him behind. However, Phasma then told KM-8713 to leave DB-7197 behind, although KM-8713 insisted that he would not slow them down. Phasma told the trooper that she had ordered them to leave him behind, but before she could finish, KM-8713 warned her of an ambushing Demirian. KM-8713 eliminated the Demirian with their F-11D blaster rifle, but the falling Demirian dropped a thermal detonator. Phasma grabbed DB-7197 and threw im on the thermal detonator as KM-8713 exclaimed in horror. The trooper's body covered the thermal detonator as it exploded, allowing Phasma and KM-8713 to survive the explosion. Phasma then informed KM-8713 they were pulling out to regroup, adding that KM-8713 will report to her command shuttle to discuss what occurred in the battle.
